title: Has subsurface oxygen declined since 1993
query: Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen, nitrate and chlorophyll for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), determine whether subsurface oxygen has declined and the hypoxic boundary (about 60 umol/kg) has shoaled since 1993, where and at which depths, whether the changes are trends or decadal variability, and what could explain them.
